_about: Litter gathers on the tiles around a drink stand, snack bar, restroom, vending machine or bar. rate is added per second on each tile of that 3 by 3. A litter bin within bin_radius metres cuts new litter to bin_cut of the rate and absorbs existing litter at absorb per second. Golfers complain once a tile reaches show. mood is the satisfaction change. patch is how many tiles out from the messy spot a porter clears, taking clean off each tile (1 clears a 3 by 3).
